tour.title: Everything you run a store with — already built in
tour.subtitle: Four parts of the platform that take up most of a merchant's day. All of them are shipped and ready the moment you create your first store.

products.label: Catalog
products.title: Add products in minutes — variants and all
products.desc: Colours, sizes, materials, bundles — define them once and every variant stays in sync. Bulk-edit prices, manage stock per warehouse, archive seasonal items in two clicks.

orders.label: Sales
orders.title: Take every order from cart to delivery
orders.desc: Confirm, pack, ship, deliver — without switching tabs. Refunds and returns live in the same pipeline. Customers get status updates from your domain, not ours.

bookings.label: Bookings
bookings.title: A calendar for service businesses
bookings.desc: Set up services, assign staff, manage opening hours. Customers pick a slot online, you see it on your calendar. Cancellations and reschedules update everyone automatically.

analytics.label: Insights
analytics.title: Know what's working — no spreadsheets
analytics.desc: Revenue, conversion, repeat-buyer cohorts, average order value by channel. Live numbers that update on every sale, with the comparisons your accountant needs.

features.title: Tools your team will actually use every day.
features.subtitle: The four big areas above are the spine. Everything below is on by default and ready to ship the moment you create a store.

customers.title: Customer profiles
customers.desc: Every shopper, every purchase, every interaction — on one page. A repeat buyer in store A shows the same profile in store B.

broadcasts.title: Email campaigns
broadcasts.desc: Send beautiful emails to your customer list, from your own domain. Built-in templates, opens and clicks tracked automatically.

auth.title: One-tap customer login
auth.desc: Shoppers sign in with a 6-digit code sent to their email. No passwords to forget, no signup friction — more checkouts.

chat.title: Live web chat
chat.desc: A chat widget your customers see on the storefront, and an inbox for your team. Every message pings everyone with access.

team.title: Team workspace
team.desc: Invite teammates to your organization. Give each one the pages they need — Products, Orders, Marketing — and nothing else.

integrations.title: Connects with what you already use
integrations.desc: Payment providers, shipping carriers, accounting tools, marketing platforms — connect them once and they stay in sync.

allInOne.title: One console instead of a dozen apps
allInOne.subtitle: Inventory, marketing, support, scheduling, analytics — every part of running an online store, in one workspace.

teamReady.title: Built for teams, not just solo founders
teamReady.subtitle: Invite designers, accountants, ops, marketers. Each one sees only the pages they need.

roles.title: Custom roles per page
roles.desc: Build a role that lets your designer change Products but not Orders. An accountant can read Revenue without touching settings.

workspace.title: One workspace, every store
workspace.desc: Invite teammates to your organization once. They get access to the stores you choose, with the permissions you grant.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.desc: Every change in your console is tracked — who, what, when. Roll back wrong edits or hand the log to your auditor.

security.title: Boring, predictable, well-isolated
security.subtitle: Security defaults nobody should have to think about — wired in from the first store you create.

twoKey.title: Two-key API access
twoKey.desc: Every storefront request needs a public key in the URL and a secret publishable key in the header — copying the link alone gets you nothing.

dkim.title: DKIM-signed email
dkim.desc: Every email you send is signed with your domain's key. SPF and DMARC records are guided through a built-in checker.

rbac.title: Page-level RBAC
rbac.desc: Permissions live on pages, not on tables. A custom role can grant view-only on Revenue and full edit on Products at the same time.

audit.title: Full audit log
audit.desc: Every change in your console — who, what, when, from where. Roll back wrong edits or hand the log to your auditor.

faq.title: FAQ
faq.subtitle: If something here isn't answered, the docs probably have the long version.

stores.q: How many stores can I run?
stores.a: There's no cap on stores inside an organization. Each store is fully isolated — products, orders, customers and team access don't leak across boundaries.

customDomain.q: Can I send email from my own domain?
customDomain.a: Yes. Add the domain in the Email page, paste the DKIM/SPF/DMARC records into your DNS, click Check, and you're live. No waiting for a sales call.

noTech.q: I'm not technical. Will I be able to set this up?
noTech.a: If you can fill in a form, you can set up Torta. The hardest step is adding your DNS records — and we walk you through it with one-click verification.

permissions.a: Per-page and per-action. You can build a role that lets a designer change Products but never touch Orders, or an analyst who can read Revenue but can't see customer emails.

bookings.q: Does this work for service businesses too?
bookings.a: Yes. The Bookings calendar handles services, staff schedules and recurring slots. Customers pick times online; cancellations and reschedules sync automatically.

migrate.q: Can I migrate from another setup?
migrate.a: Most teams import their existing catalog via CSV in the Products page, then point their site at the system. Customers and orders flow in the moment you go live.

platform.q: What if I don't have a website yet?
platform.a: We ship a ready-made storefront template you can launch in minutes. You get your products online without writing a line of code.

cta.title: Start managing your store today
cta.subtitle: Everything you've seen on this page is already wired in. Lay the foundations now — and grow from there.
